title: Dynamic dimer-of-dimers architecture defines Mg2+ transport in human CNNM4.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Queried the RCSB PDB (Protein Data Bank) API for 9Y9D, 9Y9F and 9Y9G: all released, cryo-EM (cryo-electron microscopy) structures of the human CNNM4 tetramer at 3.48, 3.69 and 3.89 Å resolution, 3,376 residues each, citing this paper. Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 and the supplement endpoint returned no zip.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: outward-facing and occluded states, Mg2+/ATP stabilisation, Na+-driven glutamate flip. Other text-mined IDs (11GQ, 7CFG, UniProt Q6P4Q7) not opened; no tabular dataset is described anywhere.

a1_downloadable.note: PDB entries 9Y9D/9Y9F/9Y9G are public and released (checked via RCSB API).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The data are a few 3D atomic models of one protein; there is no table of measured outcomes, so any label would have to be constructed.

a3_inputs_present.note: Coordinates and sequence are in the PDB entries.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable beyond standard PDB coordinate units (Å).

a5_enough_rows.note: About three to four structures of a single protein (three verified in PDB); far below the ~400 labelled rows minimum.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Model files are small; map files (EMDB, Electron Microscopy Data Bank) not checked.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Three PDB entries found match the text-mined accessions; no other counts to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: Structures are experimental cryo-EM models, not predictions; but there is no label to trace.

backbone.name: ESM-2, a protein language model (only if a variant-effect project were built elsewhere)

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: No dataset-level question; these structures are at most input features for a separate variant-effect project on CNNM-family proteins.

honest_claim_h3: With three structures of one protein, no model can be trained; the data can only serve as structural features for a project built on other data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the 3D shape of a human magnesium transporter to predict which mutations break its magnesium transport.
plain_idea.train_on: Three experimentally solved 3D structures of one protein (verified in the Protein Data Bank); no per-mutation measurements were found.
plain_idea.predict: Would be mutation effects on transport activity, but no measured mutation table is deposited with this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: CNNM4 mutations cause Jalili syndrome (a retinal and dental disorder), so variant interpretation matters, but this paper supplies structures, not labels.

label_elsewhere.why: Not filled in detail because the project is rejected at Part A.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper: it is a structural biology study with three or four PDB models and no tabular labelled data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no trainable dataset exists.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count deposited labelled rows: three PDB structures, zero tables, so it is already dead.

verdict_reason: Cryo-EM structure paper: three PDB models of one protein, no label column and nowhere near enough rows (fails A2 and A5).
